context_requirements: Cells must have intact microtubule-dependent mitotic machinery and be actively proliferating.
Functional TP53 or other apoptosis effectors can enhance the 24 h response; TP53-mutant lines may show weaker late apoptosis.
High expression of class III beta-tubulin (TUBB3) or multidrug resistance pumps may reduce sensitivity.
The 10 µM concentration must be sufficient to stabilize microtubules in the specific line; efflux or metabolic inactivation can blunt the response.
falsifiers: No significant change in any of the listed proximal or late genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines.
A clear increase in mitotic markers (e.g., CCNB1, AURKA, BIRC5) rather than the expected decrease at 24 h.
Predominant induction of generic stress programs (unfolded protein response, oxidative stress) without the expected G2/M arrest and apoptosis signature.
Strong transcriptional response in non-proliferating or quiescent cells, which would argue against a microtubule-dependent mechanism.
